name: source
description: The source the target was scheduled for. Never a source that is not cleared.

name: mode
description: sample_now or fetch_history. Only sample_now targets become sampling slots.

name: slot_start
description: The slot the dispatcher intended this target to be collected in.

name: schedule_version
description: The catalogue generation (or 'bootstrap') the plan was made from.

name: recorded_at
description: When the intent was recorded. A later plan never rewrites an earlier row.

name: landed_object
description: GCS object this row was loaded from.

name: tier
description: Monitoring tier in force when the target was due, 0 (surge) to 4 (long tail). Null on rows written before tiers existed.

name: due_at
description: The tick on which the target became due. A deferred target keeps its original value.

name: due_reason
description: Why it was due: its schedule entry or a named pin.

name: policy_status
description: The source's policy clearance and policy version when the row was written.

name: disposition
description: What the dispatcher did: planned, deferred, skipped or expired, and why. Never a sample state; NOT_SAMPLED is derived.

name: work_order_id
description: The work order that carried the target, when it was planned.
